<description>
As there are ongoing changes to the Silent Payments public key extraction function `GetPubKeyFromInput` (see recently merged #36338, upcoming #36417), it seems reasonable to add benchmarks for it. The first commit covers the standard shape of each eligible input type (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH and P2TR script-path spend; see [BIP-352](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0352.mediawiki#user-content-Inputs_For_Shared_Secret_Derivation)). The second adds a worst-case P2PKH input with a maximally malleated scriptSig, where every push has to be hashed during the scan.

Results on my arm64 machine (as per `$ ./build/bin/bench_bitcoin -filter='BIP352_.*'`):

|            ns/input |             input/s |    err% |     total | benchmark
|--------------------:|--------------------:|--------:|----------:|:----------
|            3,034.12 |          329,584.35 |    0.2% |      0.01 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2PKH`
|           69,868.20 |           14,312.66 |    0.1% |      0.01 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2PKH_WorstCase`
|            2,841.35 |          351,945.44 |    0.1% |      0.01 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_P2WPKH`
|            2,768.00 |          361,272.01 |    0.1% |      0.01 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2TR`
|            2,757.57 |          362,637.66 |    0.0% |      0.01 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2WPKH`
</description>

[2026-10-21] c:6310687100 comment by fametrano (contributor):
tACK 56c0f168d1

The five benchmarks build and run on an Apple M5 (Release build, `bench_bitcoin -filter='BIP352_.*' -min-time=2000`, three runs). The four standard inputs take 2.2-2.6 µs each. The worst case, a 10,000-byte P2PKH scriptSig with 291 dummy pushes, takes 39-43 µs. I also rebuilt the five input shapes independently. A separate BIP352 implementation (btclib-wallet) extracts the expected key from each.
</new_statements>
